text:
Select: activity_id, standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, assay_id, assay_type, assay_organism, assay_tax_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, compound_records.compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, docs.title AS literature_title
Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, docs
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND activities.target_id = target_dictionary.tid AND activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id AND compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno AND activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Filter: activities.standard_relation = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_units = 'nM' AND assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.tid = 3879801 AND molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'
Sort: activities.standard_value ASC, compound_records.compound_name ASC
Limit: 100
